value.decision: R35 accepted a bounded docs-only consolidation, capability snapshot, and candidate ranking. The reviewer audit selected public catalog hygiene as the next bounded initiative because R35-T2 verified stale capability documentation and R35-T3 ranked it as low-medium risk without dependency on held MinerU lanes.
